Car Classes
Championships
Cars in Forza Horizon 4 are purchaseable from the Autoshow, Forzathon Shop and Auction House. Additional cars for purchase may be acquired through downloadable content.

A series of cars cannot be obtained directly and are rewarded to players in different manners including Barn Finds, Wheelspin cars, Horizon Life rewards, Player House rewards, Festival Playlist-only cars that may be made unlockable again in a future Season, and the Horizon Backstage.

There are also special car variants in the game including Preorder Cars that come with bespoke upgrade presets and Forza Edition cars, which come with upgrade presets and a gameplay progression perk. Several special car variants such as Horizon Story cars are only playable in certain gameplay events.

Most unlockable cars can be listed in and bought from the Auction House. Alternatively, a series of cars are featured in the Forzathon Shop for the duration of a Season, where they can be bought for a specific amount of Forzathon Points.

Each car is categorised within a division that puts it against similar cars for events and PR Stunts:

  • Classic Muscle
  • Classic Racers
  • Classic Rally
  • Classic Sports Cars
  • Cult Cars
  • Extreme Offroad
  • Extreme Track Toys
  • GT Cars
  • Hot Hatch
  • Hypercars

Trivia[]

  • A large portion of the car list was leaked on June 23, 2018 by a reddit user after the title was mistakenly made available for download for users that have pre-ordered the title.[2] It revealed the return of Barn Finds and Forza Edition cars, as well as the addition of Horizon Stories cars.
    • Another portion of the car list was leaked on August 11, 2018 on gtplanet.net that included 'Bond' variant cars as notable additions.[3][4]
  • On September 7, 2018, an official car list featuring the majority of the more than 450 cars available to play at launch was released, which also revealed the absence of Mitsubishi cars in Forza Horizon 4.[5]
    • Later on the 15th of January 2019, Mitsubishi returned with the release of the Free Mitsubishi Motors Car Pack DLC.[6]
